provenance.cycle_note: A Reviewer verdict is not cycle-scoped; this is the first (and only) Review of attempt 0.

evidence.locator: candidate-creation requires owner credential bindings before any provider launch
Workspace.create/2 initializes bindings as [] and writes the running owner record before later binding
run_in_candidate/2 invokes open_roles before Workspace.bind/2 writes credential bindings; open_roles performs readiness/provider calls first

findings.reason: The running owner record is created with an empty credential_bindings list. Credential bindings are persisted only after Kogen.Harness.open_roles/4 completes readiness, so the record does not satisfy the contract's requirement that it name bindings before any provider launch.
